categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in pharmaceutical distribution and retail, including B2B pharmaceutical e-commerce, pharmaceutical wholesale, retail pharmacy chains, and medical logistics. It also engages in pharmaceutical manufacturing through OEM and MAH businesses, invests in traditional Chinese medicine, ethnic medicine, special medical foods, medical devices, and synthetic biology. Additionally, it provides digital healthcare services, internet medical services, and operates investment funds in the healthcare sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digital technologies such as AI, big data analytics, and intelligent supply chain management systems including ERP, WMS, TMS, and SaaS platforms. It employs OEM and MAH production models for pharmaceuticals, integrates AI-driven retail and marketing systems, and develops smart medical devices and wearable health monitoring equipment. The company also focuses on digital transformation with data resource management and AI-powered decision-making platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical manufacturers, medical institutions, retail pharmacies, clinics, and end consumers. The company serves a broad range of markets across pharmaceutical distribution, retail, and healthcare services, with a focus on the Chinese domestic market, especially hospital-external (院外) pharmaceutical markets. It also targets chronic disease management and ethnic medicine markets, and engages in online-to-offline (O2O) retail and e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant presence in Southwest China (notably Sichuan), as well as Northwest, North, Central, South, East, and Northeast China. It has subsidiaries and investments in multiple provinces and municipalities including Sichuan, Chongqing, Guangdong, Henan, and Hainan. The company also has limited overseas operations, including Hong Kong and cross-border e-commerce.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream pharmaceutical manufacturing (OEM/MAH), midstream pharmaceutical distribution and logistics, and downstream retail pharmacy chains and direct-to-consumer sales. It positions itself as a supply chain integrator and ecosystem builder, linking production, distribution, retail, and end-user services with digital and AI technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding upstream product pricing power through OEM, MAH, and equity investments; deepening digital transformation and AI-driven supply chain and retail capabilities; developing ethnic and traditional Chinese medicine brands; investing in medical devices and health foods; and building a comprehensive SBbC (Suppliers to key Business partners to small Business partners to Customers) ecosystem. R&D focuses on pharmaceutical product development, digital platforms, AI applications, and smart healthcare solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales including pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale, and retail sales both online and offline. The company also earns income from service fees related to digital healthcare platforms, advertising and promotional services for suppliers, and investment returns from equity holdings and funds. The e-commerce platform operates mainly on product sales with some advertising revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the Chinese pharmaceutical distribution and e-commerce sector, recognized as the first pharmaceutical industry internet listed company in China. It ranks 34th in pharmaceutical wholesale revenue nationally. Competitors include other pharmaceutical distributors, retail chains, and emerging internet healthcare platforms. The company differentiates itself through its integrated SBbC ecosystem, digital capabilities, and upstream product control.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 4.38 billion RMB, a slight decline of 1.12% from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 16.36 million RMB, down 72.52% year-over-year. The company has a total asset base of about 1.72 billion RMB and equity attributable to shareholders of approximately 850 million RMB. Despite recent profit declines, the company is investing in growth areas such as C-end retail and digital transformation, with rapid growth in online retail sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated pharmaceutical supply chain ecosystem powered by advanced digital and AI technologies, enabling efficient end-to-end service from production to consumer. It differentiates through exclusive upstream product rights (OEM/MAH), ethnic and traditional medicine brands, comprehensive digital retail solutions including AI new retail and chronic disease management, and a broad multi-channel presence. Its value proposition includes high-quality, differentiated pharmaceutical products, innovative health management services, and strong customer and supplier empowerment.
